why_grouped: None of the six is a modelled element. They have L0 schemas and verbs but no mesh, and they are the SURFACES the other families are drawn onto. Included because the brief asks for every member and whether the undrawn ones are HONEST about it.

rows.invoked_by: apps/editor/src/engine/engineLauncher.ts:122 `import { registerSectionHandlers } from '@pryzm/plugin-section-view'`. Registered by plugins/section-view/src/registration.ts, NOT by an inline ALL_PLUGINS descriptor (apps/editor/src/PluginRegistry.ts:112 and census.json S2 both record this).
rows.drawn: YES — it is the only family whose plugin owns a whole render surface.
rows.⛔ KNOWN_OPEN_DEFECT_ON_RECORD: apps/editor/src/engine/persistence/snapshotFamilyCoverage.ts:168 — 'L-11524 (OPEN) — SectionStore (plugins/section-view) has no snapshot key, so every section view the user cuts is lost on reload. Sibling of `view`, whose ViewRegistry DOES persist via `viewDefinitions`; the asymmetry is real and undeclared until now.'

rows.honest_about_it: YES on both — each gap is a named, dated register row in the file that would otherwise have hidden it.
